probes.title: Cross-sector coupling
probes.trigger_basis: measure names or implies a second sector

probes.title: Institutional handoff
probes.trigger_basis: measure depends on another institutional actor

probes.title: Feedback loops
probes.trigger_basis: measure suggests uptake, demand, participation, prices, or response effects

probes.title: Success changes demand
probes.trigger_basis: measure success may alter demand or participation

probes.title: Delay and time horizon
probes.trigger_basis: time_to_benefit in months or years

probes.trigger_basis: time_to_benefit in months or years and interim provision is not named

probes.title: Leverage-point depth
probes.trigger_basis: systemic self-evaluation >= 7 and leverage_depth parameter

probes.title: Rules unchanged
probes.trigger_basis: measure changes amount or rate but not eligibility, delivery, or success criteria

probes.title: Policy resistance and rebound
probes.trigger_basis: action_type is subsidy, grant, tariff, or tax

probes.title: Capacity and stock constraints
probes.trigger_basis: measure requires delivery capacity or stock

probes.title: Problem framing
probes.trigger_basis: fallback boundary critique

probes.title: Untested assumptions
probes.trigger_basis: any validation dimension verdict is insufficient

probes.title: Evidence gap carried forward
probes.trigger_basis: validation evidence quality, contraindications, or feasibility is insufficient

probes.title: Worldview plurality and expertise
probes.trigger_basis: measure defines eligibility or success criteria

probes.title: Boundary judgements of power and legitimacy
probes.trigger_basis: measure delegates delivery to an intermediary

probes.title: Delegated discretion
probes.trigger_basis: intermediary has discretion over access or prioritisation

probes.title: Distributional incidence
probes.trigger_basis: cost_incidence is upfront or ongoing user cost

probes.title: Reimbursement gap
probes.trigger_basis: measure requires reimbursement, contribution, deposit, or bridge finance

probes.title: Recognition
probes.trigger_basis: affected group omitted from target population

probes.title: Protective predictor ambiguity
probes.trigger_basis: survey predictor is protective or negative and could be misread as low need

probes.title: Procedural access
probes.trigger_basis: delivery_channel is application, means-tested, or intermediary

probes.title: Documentation barrier
probes.trigger_basis: application process requires proof, certification, digital access, or documents

probes.title: Long-term burden
probes.trigger_basis: time_to_benefit is years or measure creates a long-lived asset

source_refs.locator: §5.3 Lens catalogue / C4 Intergenerational and ecological burden

probes.title: Maintenance burden
probes.trigger_basis: long-lived asset creates maintenance or lock-in duties

source_refs.locator: §5.3 Lens catalogue / C4 Intergenerational and ecological burden

probes.title: Measure interaction
probes.trigger_basis: current and prior measures have a deterministic policy tension

probes.title: Competing sequencing
probes.trigger_basis: two measures depend on different ordering assumptions

probes.title: Cumulative burden
probes.trigger_basis: current and prior measure share a target group

probes.title: Repeated administrative demand
probes.trigger_basis: same group is asked to navigate repeated administrative steps

probes.title: Leverage concentration
probes.trigger_basis: at least three parameter-level measures in the session

probes.title: Portfolio learning plateau
probes.trigger_basis: successive measures keep the same leverage depth despite prior reflections
